meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use null for max to mean no upper bound. A number always means that number — there is no magic threshold. (999 is still read as no-bound for older files, but is deprecated: write null.)

general.description: Photosynthetic colony organisms found on icy worlds. They melt surrounding ice, absorb liquid through cellular pores, and refreeze it into protective translucent exoskeletons. Colonies reproduce via fragmentation when structural pieces break off and form new growths.
environmental_context: Commonly found on flat terrain near craters or rocky surfaces

species.description: Tall species with large leaf-like structures for sunlight absorption.
species._atmosphereNote: Argon-dominant, and that is the whole of what separates it from Fonticulua upupam: campestris 51.97-100% argon over 761 bodies, upupam 0.36-49.68% over 56, two ranges that do not touch. The label cannot tell them apart - 'ArgonRich' air averages 3.0% argon and is usually nitrogen - so upupam sat at 15-17% on bodies that were unmistakably its own while campestris, with thirteen times the rows, stayed above it on the corpus prior alone. See tests/atmosphereGasShare.test.ts.

species._atmosphereNote: The mirror of Bacterium acies, and the other half of that fix. All 16 of its observed bodies are Thin Neon-rich and it has never been seen anywhere else - at 0.2-0.5% neon, which is a nitrogen world carrying a trace. Its row reads Neon and Neon-rich, both of which the loader folds to Neon, so it matched the 50-100% neon bodies that are acies' and where it has never once grown. Neon-rich is 14.5% of neon habitats, so landing 16 of 16 on it has probability 4e-14 under indifference. The floor of 0.1% keeps the neon requirement real: a pure nitrogen world with no neon at all is Fonticulua lapida's, not this one. See tests/atmosphereGasShare.test.ts.

species.description: Argon-rich variant with hoop-shaped structures for reflecting light.
species._atmosphereNote: The mirror of campestris, and the reason the band exists: upupam is 0.36-49.68% argon on all 56 of its bodies while campestris is 51.97-100% on 761. 'Argon-rich' in the row is folded to 'Argon' by the loader, and the game's own ArgonRich label means argon present but not dominant - averaging 3.0%, the rest usually nitrogen. The floor of 0.1% keeps the argon requirement real: a nitrogen world with no argon at all is not upupam's either. No nitrogen rule is written here on purpose - nitrogen is missing from AtmosphereType 59.7% of the time it is present, and tests/requiredAtmosphereShare.test.ts fails if one ever is. See tests/atmosphereGasShare.test.ts.

special_rules: ALL species require thin atmosphere (hard requirement)
STRICT biome: only Icy or Rocky Ice planets
Atmosphere type is the ONLY species differentiator
No volcanism, temperature, or system-level dependencies
Color is entirely star-type based (uniform across genus)
